title: Split a chat-folders feature into router, service and dependencies
problem: Chat folders (like Work, Family, Bots) need an API. repository.py (storage) and main.py (app, router inclusion, domain-error handlers) are finished. Write services.py (the rules, with no FastAPI), deps.py (wiring with Depends) and folders_router.py (the HTTP layer) so the app works and each layer can be tested on its own.
requirements: services.FolderService(repo, max_folders=3) with create(name), get(id), list(), delete(id); no fastapi import anywhere in services.py
create: strip the name; blank -> ValueError; same name ignoring case -> FolderNameTaken; already max_folders folders -> FolderLimitReached; else store and return the folder
get and delete: unknown id -> FolderNotFound. list: folders sorted by name, ignoring case
deps.get_repository() returns one shared FolderRepository (the same object every call); deps.get_folder_service depends on get_repository and returns a FolderService around it
folders_router.router has prefix "/folders" and tags ["folders"], and the endpoints POST /folders (201), GET /folders, GET /folders/{folder_id}, DELETE /folders/{folder_id} (204, empty body)
Bodies are {"name": str}; a blank name is a 422 before the service is called; responses are {"id": int, "name": str}
contract: FolderService(repo: FolderRepository, max_folders: int = 3); deps.get_repository() -> FolderRepository; deps.get_folder_service(repo) -> FolderService; folders_router.router: APIRouter
expectedBehavior: POST /folders {"name": "Work"} -> 201 {"id": 1, "name": "Work"}; POST {"name": "work"} -> 409 folder name already taken; a 4th folder -> 409 folder limit reached; GET /folders/7 -> 404 folder not found
edgeCases: "   " is rejected: ValueError in the service, 422 over HTTP
Deleting a folder frees a slot under the limit
Sorting ignores case: bots before Work
Each test injects its own empty repository via dependency_overrides
hints: Conceptual: start with the service and its tests (no HTTP at all), then the two dependency functions, then the router. Each layer only calls the one below it.

Specific: the service raises the three exception classes already defined in services.py; main.py maps them to 404/409. get_repository needs @lru_cache. The router needs APIRouter(prefix=..., tags=[...]) and an Annotated alias for Depends(get_folder_service).

Implementation: in create, strip, reject blank with ValueError, compare casefold() against self.repo.all(), check len(existing) >= self.max_folders, then return self.repo.add(clean). For the body model, ConfigDict(str_strip_whitespace=True) with Field(min_length=1) turns "   " into a 422.
evaluation: services.py has no FastAPI or HTTP status codes
Routers contain no business rules; each endpoint is one service call
Wiring goes through Depends, so tests can override the repository
